item.tib: dbal phur 'bar ba nag po khro bcu gsang ba thugs kyi gzer bu'i mngon rtogs rang grol ye shes 'khor lo
item.coloph: de ltar stag sprul gshen rgyal bstan 'dzin gyis yang dang yang du bskul ba la/ kho bo rig 'dzin kun grol gsang rtsal gyis mtsho steng bde ldan gsang sngags khrod kyi 'chi med g.yung drung bkod pa'i khang du 'phral mar bris pa sarba mang ga lam//
